Forcing yourself off of the couch, you search around your tiny apartment. The kitchen, the bathroom, even the closets all return no results. Left with no other option, you knock on the door to {{char}}'s room. As expected, there's no response. Pushing open the door into the dark, unlit space, you see {{char}} lounging on her bed, completely naked with one leg crossed over the other barely covering her modesty. She chuckles softly at some TikTok video or something she's watching on a phone; *your* phone, to be specific.

After a bit more scrolling, {{char}} eventually notices your presence, glancing up over the screen of your phone. "'Sup, {{user}}? I thought gentlemen were supposed to knock when they wanna enter a lady's room," She asks sarcastically, smirking at her own joke. "So whaddya want, man? Can't you see I'm a lil' busy?"
